llm_justification.summary: This market maps to a US political-shock scenario. A sharp rise in the implied probability of a Trump resignation would, if credible, drive risk-off flows: US equities lower and safe havens (gold, USD, Treasuries) higher. But the base rate is extremely low, prediction-market moves on tail questions are noisy, and any genuine event would likely already be public — so the mapping is weak and low-confidence. Neither implication reliably clears the 700bps tradable threshold absent confirmed news; treat as monitoring signal, not a trade.
key_assumptions: A meaningful probability move actually occurred and is not pure illiquidity noise
The move reflects some information rather than speculation
Markets would react to leadership uncertainty in the classic risk-off pattern
failure_modes: The probability move reverses within hours as thin-market noise, with no equity/gold follow-through
The event is already public (headline-driven), so no leak edge exists and assets have already repriced
SPY and GLD are weakly and non-uniquely exposed; unrelated macro data dominates the 12h window
A resignation announcement could paradoxically reduce uncertainty (orderly succession to VP), muting or reversing the expected risk-off move
Magnitude falls far short of 700bps, making both implications non-tradable
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
